summary: Churchill Capital Corp XI (SPAC) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Agility Robotics, Inc. via a reverse merger. The SPAC will domesticate from Cayman to Delaware and change its name to Agility Robotics. Terms such as implied equity value, price per share, and premium are not disclosed in this excerpt. The transaction requires shareholder approvals and customary closing conditions. No board recommendation or advisors are named here. The SPAC's trust cash plus a PIPE investment (defined but not quantified) will fund the deal. Watch for shareholder vote timeline and redemption risk; the risk-arb angle hinges on trust value per share and PIPE backstop.
